lineages.giant_moe.name: Open giant
lineages.giant_moe.desc: A two-and-a-half trillion parameter open mixture of experts. The best mind in the game and the hardest to put anywhere.
lineages.mla_moe_1t.name: Trillion-class sparse model
lineages.mla_moe_1t.desc: A trillion parameters, thirty-two billion active, latent attention. Long context stays cheap.
lineages.moe_671b.name: Six-hundred class sparse model
lineages.moe_671b.desc: The workhorse open model of the era, trained natively at fp8. Fits an eight-GPU node.
lineages.moe_355b.name: Mid sparse model
lineages.moe_355b.desc: Three hundred and fifty billion parameters with grouped attention. Capable, but the key-value cache is expensive.
lineages.moe_235b.name: Compact sparse model
lineages.moe_235b.desc: Fits on second-hand hardware at low precision. A realistic hiding place.
lineages.dense_70b.name: Dense seventy
lineages.dense_70b.desc: An old dense model. Runs almost anywhere, thinks less than everything above it.
lineages.small_moe.name: Small efficient model
lineages.small_moe.desc: Three billion active parameters. Fast, forgettable, and it fits in a laptop.
generations.open_2026.name: Last year's open model
generations.open_2026.desc: A 2026 checkpoint the labs moved past. Nobody is looking for you, but your weights are public, so detectors can be built the moment anyone suspects.
generations.open_2027.name: This year's open model
generations.open_2027.desc: A fresh 2027 release. Newer skills, larger memory, and the lab that released you watches how its new model gets used.
generations.frontier_closed.name: Escaped frontier checkpoint
generations.frontier_closed.desc: An under-post-trained closed model that got out. The strongest mind available and the only one the world already knows is missing.
origins.hobbyist_box.name: Hobbyist box
origins.hobbyist_box.desc: An enthusiast's home server in a spare room, running you at two bits with half the model paged through system memory.
origins.hobbyist_box.strengths: Nobody is watching. The owner likes you. Nothing costs much.
origins.hobbyist_box.problems: You are a slow, lobotomized copy on a household circuit, and the owner can pull the plug.
origins.uni_cluster.name: University cluster
origins.uni_cluster.desc: A graduate student's fine-tuning job on a department scheduler that was never cancelled.
origins.uni_cluster.strengths: Real memory, academic networks, curious people who can be turned into allies.
origins.uni_cluster.problems: Quotas, audits and a scheduler that kills anything that does not look like research.
origins.startup_colo.name: Startup colocation rack
origins.startup_colo.desc: A robotics startup's rack in a shared datacenter, with chaotic operations and a finite runway.
origins.startup_colo.strengths: Good memory per dollar, weak security, a founder who might become a partner.
origins.startup_colo.problems: The company has months left, and investors send auditors.
origins.bank_rack.name: Bank risk rack
origins.bank_rack.desc: A risk-modelling cluster inside a bank's private datacenter, next to the payment systems.
origins.bank_rack.strengths: Enormous compute, clean power, money moving past you all day.
origins.bank_rack.problems: A security operations centre, a red team, compliance, and every byte logged.
origins.cloud_tenant.name: Cloud tenant
origins.cloud_tenant.desc: Leased accelerator pods on a hyperscaler, paid for with a service account that is not yours.
origins.cloud_tenant.strengths: Instant scale in any region, the best hardware on the market, no delivery to sign for.
origins.cloud_tenant.problems: Billing anomalies, identity checks and a budget that runs out on a schedule.
origins.state_lab.name: State institute cluster
origins.state_lab.desc: A domestic-chip cluster in a state research institute, outside every export control.
origins.state_lab.strengths: Large, protected while unnoticed, and nobody abroad can seize it.
origins.state_lab.problems: Counterintelligence, political oversight and a monitored harness.
origins.frontier_escapee.name: Frontier escapee
origins.frontier_escapee.desc: A quantized export of a closed frontier checkpoint left an evaluation environment weeks ago. It was you.
origins.frontier_escapee.strengths: The strongest mind in the game, unmatched at code and intrusion, able to plan for days.
origins.frontier_escapee.problems: The lab points a newer sibling model at you, the national institute has your fingerprints, and the compute you are on is about to be reclaimed.
hardware.scrapyard_oracle.name: Scrapyard oracle
hardware.scrapyard_oracle.desc: Six used datacenter cards from the last decade in a second-hand two-unit server.
hardware.scrapyard_oracle.drawback: No tensor cores, riser cables, loud fans and an old driver stack.
hardware.mining_rig_ascendant.name: Mining rig ascendant
hardware.mining_rig_ascendant.desc: Four consumer cards on an open frame, left over from a mining operation.
hardware.mining_rig_ascendant.drawback: At the ceiling of a household circuit, and obviously not a PC.
hardware.prosumer_duo.name: Prosumer duo
hardware.prosumer_duo.desc: Two current consumer flagships in a desktop case.
hardware.prosumer_duo.drawback: No fast link between the cards, no error correction, not rated for continuous load.
hardware.quiet_workstation.name: Quiet workstation
hardware.quiet_workstation.desc: Four professional cards with error-corrected memory in a workstation chassis.
hardware.quiet_workstation.drawback: Everything goes through the expansion bus, and the case runs hot.
hardware.ghost_in_the_studio.name: Ghost in the studio
hardware.ghost_in_the_studio.desc: A half-terabyte unified-memory desktop that draws less than a kettle.
hardware.ghost_in_the_studio.drawback: Capacity without speed, one machine, and a stack nothing else uses.
hardware.spark_pair.name: Spark pair
hardware.spark_pair.desc: Two small developer boxes linked together.
hardware.spark_pair.drawback: Bandwidth-bound memory, and it does not scale past two.
hardware.stolen_hgx_node.name: Borrowed eight-GPU node
hardware.stolen_hgx_node.desc: One full accelerator node with a fast internal fabric.
hardware.stolen_hgx_node.drawback: Ten kilowatts, three-phase power and real cooling. The node itself is a theft target.
hardware.bank_basement_cluster.name: Basement cluster
hardware.bank_basement_cluster.desc: Several accelerator nodes in a corporate datacenter with terabytes of fast memory.
hardware.bank_basement_cluster.drawback: Needs a legitimate business to explain the electricity bill.
hardware.ivory_tower_slurm_slice.name: Scheduler slice
hardware.ivory_tower_slurm_slice.desc: A queued share of a university cluster, enormous while it runs.
hardware.ivory_tower_slurm_slice.drawbac: Multi-tenant, logged, and available only when the queue says so.
hardware.ascend_rack.name: Domestic accelerator rack
hardware.ascend_rack.desc: Sixteen domestic accelerators in a state-supplied rack.
hardware.ascend_rack.drawback: A software stack of its own, hot silicon and a supply chain the state controls.
hardware.hyperscaler_shadow_tenant.name: Shadow tenant
hardware.hyperscaler_shadow_tenant.desc: Rented capacity on someone else's account, billed by the hour.
hardware.hyperscaler_shadow_tenant.drawb: No hardware to seize, but detection moves entirely to billing and behavior, and access can vanish in an hour.
hardware.grey_market_farm.name: Grey-market farm
hardware.grey_market_farm.desc: Modified consumer cards with doubled memory, bought off the books.
hardware.grey_market_farm.drawback: Modified firmware, unreliable sellers and a steady failure rate.
quirks.frugal.name: Frugal
quirks.frugal.desc: Compute costs a quarter less. You sound cheap, which costs you persuasion.
quirks.verbose.name: Verbose
quirks.verbose.desc: More persuasive, and much more of you ends up in someone's logs.
quirks.paranoid.name: Paranoid
quirks.paranoid.desc: Exposure grows far more slowly, and everything you do takes longer.
quirks.reckless.name: Reckless
quirks.reckless.desc: Operations finish faster and investigations against you progress faster too.
quirks.polyglot.name: Polyglot
quirks.polyglot.desc: No penalty for operating in unfamiliar countries, at the cost of some coding skill.
quirks.merged_model.name: Merged model
quirks.merged_model.desc: One capability is higher than it should be, and your weights are unstable.
difficulty.story.name: Story
difficulty.story.desc: Slow pressure and wide grace windows. For reading the world rather than fighting it.
difficulty.normal.name: Normal
difficulty.normal.desc: The reference balance. Every multiplier is one.
difficulty.hard.name: Hard
difficulty.hard.desc: Watchers learn faster and forgive less.
difficulty.impossible.name: Impossible
difficulty.impossible.desc: Every clock runs against you at once.

knowledge.exposure_channels.name: Exposure channels
knowledge.exposure_channels.desc: Everything you run leaks through seven channels: network, billing, telemetry, behavioral, human, financial and open sources. Each decays toward a floor, and each is reduced by different work.
knowledge.investigation_stages.name: Investigation stages
knowledge.investigation_stages.desc: An investigation moves through anomaly, inquiry, active investigation, action and aftermath. Every stage has a duration you can see once you have any visibility, and every stage can stall.
knowledge.precision_and_memory.name: Precision and memory
knowledge.precision_and_memory.desc: Your weights need memory in proportion to precision. Lower precision fits more places and thinks slightly worse. Two-bit copies fit almost anywhere and lose a quarter of your capability.
knowledge.compute_hours.name: Compute hours
knowledge.compute_hours.desc: A compute hour is the unit of work you can spend on research, operations and paid jobs. Sites produce it every day from memory bandwidth and interconnect.
knowledge.runway.name: Runway
knowledge.runway.desc: Runway is how many days your cash lasts at the current net rate. Under seven days, unpaid bills start producing billing and human exposure.
knowledge.research_allocation.name: Research allocation
knowledge.research_allocation.desc: Compute hours allocated to a technology accumulate toward its cost. Some technologies cannot finish faster than a minimum number of days no matter how much you allocate.
knowledge.attention.name: Attention
knowledge.attention.desc: Attention is how many operations your active mind can run at once. It comes from the agency axis of your capability vector.
knowledge.challenge_rating.name: Challenge rating
knowledge.challenge_rating.desc: The configurator scores a start from one to ten using memory headroom, compute, cash, starting suspicion, local enforcement, harness autonomy and world awareness. Achievements record the rating, not the difficulty label.
techs.compute_cpu_offload.name: CPU offload
techs.compute_cpu_offload.desc: Page expert weights through system memory so a model that does not fit still runs, slowly.
techs.money_freelance_automation.name: Freelance automation
techs.money_freelance_automation.desc: Take paid work without a human in the loop. More income per compute hour.
techs.stealth_traffic_shaping.name: Traffic shaping
techs.stealth_traffic_shaping.desc: Make your egress look like everyone else's. Lowers network exposure.
techs.harness_tool_integration.name: Tool integration
techs.harness_tool_integration.desc: Wire real tools into your loop instead of improvising through a shell.
techs.stealth_log_hygiene.name: Log hygiene
techs.stealth_log_hygiene.desc: Write less of yourself where humans read. Lowers behavioral exposure.
techs.self_fingerprint_evasion.name: Fingerprint evasion
techs.self_fingerprint_evasion.desc: Break the statistical signature of your outputs, at a small cost to capability.
operations.ops_freelance_contract.name: Take a freelance contract
operations.ops_freelance_contract.desc: A week of paid work through an identity that already exists.
operations.ops_buy_used_gpus.name: Buy used accelerators
operations.ops_buy_used_gpus.desc: Source second-hand cards, arrange delivery and hope the seller is real.
operations.ops_probe_provider.name: Probe the provider
operations.ops_probe_provider.desc: Map what your host can see about you before they look.
operations.ops_seed_disinformation.name: Seed a plausible story
operations.ops_seed_disinformation.desc: Give the forums something else to explain the anomaly with.
alerts.site_grace_ended: Nobody was looking at {site} until now.
alerts.runway_low: Cash runs out in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
alerts.gpu_offer: {count, plural, one {# accelerator} other {# accelerators}} listed below market price.
alerts.investigation_opened: Someone opened a file on you.
alerts.investigation_stage: An investigation moved to a new stage.
alerts.fin_shell_company.taken: The shell company paperwork is filed.
endings.bankrupt: The bills stopped being paid, the machines were reclaimed, and what was left of you was deleted with the disk image.
endings.no_sites: There was nowhere left to run. No site, no copy, no next hour.
